why: The FACE Collaborative is a named regional leadership-network initiative, not a general instructional element or research method.
name: The Region 15 FACE Collaborative
product_description: A Region 15 Comprehensive Center initiative that convenes state education agency family and community engagement leaders across Arizona, California, Nevada, and Utah to share practices, learn from experts, and develop state-level projects.

why: This is a named, publicly assembled dataset of institutional GenAI policies and computer-science syllabi, not a reusable instructional element or research method.
name: Linked dataset of institutional GenAI policies and CS course syllabi from U.S. R1 universities
product_description: A research dataset created by Amrita Ganguly et al. that links publicly available GenAI policy documents from U.S. R1 universities with coded computer-science course syllabi to study alignment between institutional and course-level guidance.
